aboutText:
## **Hello! I’m Farhan Labib. This is my personal website**.





Education:

My academic journey has been shaped by a strong foundation in Dinajpur, leading me to my current studies in Dhaka.



I continued my higher secondary studies at Ideal Residential Model School, Chirirbandar, Dinajpur, and passed SSC as a proud member of the Class of 2026 (Batch 2K26)



Currently, I am pursuing my higher education at Dhaka College, having started my academic session there on September 24, 2026.
